Commerce Ministry to Discuss SEZ Reforms with Stakeholders

India's Commerce Ministry has scheduled a meeting for June 30th with stakeholders to discuss reforms for Special Economic Zones (SEZs). The meeting aims to address issues and potential changes within the SEZ framework. This initiative highlights the government's focus on improving economic zones.
